correctness.rationale: The connected weighted-six-circulant Laplacian has explicitly verified eigenvalues with multiplicity 2,2,1. Fourier formulas give all three resistance and squared-pseudoinverse classes; a Schur-complement calculation proves the grounded trace formula C_r=tr(G)+6g0-e_r/d_r-3d_r. Exact factorizations show distance one is dominated by distance two, establish a unique positive quadratic root c_R and unique positive quartic root c_C, with c_R<4<c_C. Complete endpoint and strict sign classifications follow. A standalone symbolic checker reproduces the factorizations and exact direct inversions for 18 grounded cases; the proof over all c>0 is analytic, not enumeration.

Fitch–Leonard Corollary 1 supplies the broader joint-centrality framework but not the window; their Section V-C statement that maximum resistance suffices for equal-centrality graphs is contradicted by the verified instance, rather than implying it. value.rationale: A sharp open conductance interval on a small, nondegenerate symmetric positive-weight network separates maximal electrical resistance from optimal noise-free stochastic coherence despite equal node centralities. The exact threshold pair and rational instance identify precisely how a natural resistance-only optimization shortcut can fail and supply a reproducible benchmark, beyond a routine single-entry computation.
